title: Interview with a chef
instructions: Radyoda bir aşçıyla röportaj. Uzun bir diyalog; geçmişi, bugünü ve planları ayırt et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Today I'm talking to Marco Bianchi, the chef at Bella Cucina. Welcome, Marco.

script.speaker: chef
script.text: When I was ten. My grandmother taught me to make pasta in her kitchen in Naples.

script.speaker: host
script.text: And you came to London when?

script.speaker: chef
script.text: Fifteen years ago. At first I washed dishes in a hotel. It was hard work, and my English was terrible!

script.speaker: host
script.text: Now you have your own restaurant. What is the most popular dish?

script.speaker: chef
script.text: People think it's the pizza, but actually it's our seafood pasta.

script.speaker: host
script.text: What do you cook at home?

script.speaker: chef
script.text: Honestly? Very simple food. Eggs, salad, bread. I'm tired of cooking after work!

script.speaker: chef
script.text: Next spring, I'm opening a cooking school for children. I want them to learn that cooking is fun.
